ContentDesc_Des Händlers kuriose Liebesm: The Merchant's Tale depicts a Corvos from before the Garlean occupation, made even more wondrous by the flourishes of countless storytellers throughout the ages. As you relate the details of your time within its pages to Osmon, he continues the timeless storytelling tradition by adding his own embellishments to an already fantastic fable, and you feel yourself drawn back in to the beautiful but increasingly dangerous world of folklore...
Instancecontenttextdata_43626_Text: Let our song ring ever louder!
Instancecontenttextdata_43631_Text: Dance with me. Let the beat of our hearts guide our steps.
Instancecontenttextdata_43737_Text: Take up your weapon. I pray you can provide some measure of entertainment before you die.
Instancecontenttextdata_43740_Text: Know this: none can escape their fate.
Instancecontenttextdata_43741_Text: Whence shall my blade strike? Look well!
Instancecontenttextdata_43742_Text: Bear witness to the Unyielding Blade!
Instancecontenttextdata_43744_Text: Hah hah, good, good! Perhaps you shall not disappoint after all!
Instancecontenttextdata_43750_Text: Come now, you can do better than that!
Instancecontenttextdata_43768_Text: From where shall death take you? I shall grant you the mercy of foresight.
Npcyell_2784_Text: Lay down your weapons and the old man lives!
